description: This file defines repository classes and methods for handling commit data in a database, including inserting commits, retrieving recent commits, and getting first seen timestamps.

classes.name: NullCommit
classes.description: Null object implementation for commit repository, returns stored error for all methods.

classes.name: Commit
classes.description: Repository class for commit data, handles database operations such as insert, fetch most recent, and get first seen timestamps.

methods.name: NullCommit.InsertCommitRows
methods.description: Returns the original error stored in the NullCommit object.

methods.name: NullCommit.GetFirstSeenTimestamp
methods.description: Returns the original error stored in the NullCommit object.

methods.name: NullCommit.GetMostRecentCommits
methods.description: Returns the original error stored in the NullCommit object.

methods.name: Commit.WithTimestampGenerator
methods.description: Returns a new Commit object with a specified timestamp generator function.

methods.name: Commit.InsertCommitRows
methods.description: Inserts commit rows into the database within a transaction.

methods.name: Commit.GetMostRecentOuterKey
methods.description: Retrieves the latest commit timestamp and UUID for the target.

methods.name: Commit.GetMostRecentCommits
methods.description: Fetches the most recent commit rows based on the latest timestamp and UUID.

methods.name: Commit.GetFirstSeenTimestamp
methods.description: Returns a map of commit hashes to their first seen timestamps, querying the database.

methods.name: NewCommitRepository
methods.description: Creates a new Commit repository instance with a database connection.

methods.name: NewNullObject
methods.description: Creates a new NullCommit object with a specified error.
